title: Apollo 11 Landed on the Moon With 30 Seconds of Fuel Left

scenes.text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon with 30 seconds of fuel left.
Minutes earlier, the computer flashed a 1202 alarm.
Then the autopilot aimed at a crater full of boulders.
So Armstrong took manual control to find a flat spot.
Houston radioed: thirty seconds of fuel.

description:
Apollo 11 landed on the Moon with 30 seconds of fuel left.
Guinness lists it as the least fuel left on a moon landing: Armstrong flew manually past a boulder field after a computer alarm.
Could you have stayed calm?
thumbnail_text: 30 SECONDS FROM CRASHING ON THE MOON
first_comment: Bonus: the alarm was a 1202, meaning the computer was overloaded. Houston called it a go.
